name: CHD-006 / CR-010 / PAR-007 - child requests extra time, parent approves it @CHD-006 @CR-010 @PAR-007 @destructive

steps.name: the parent account has no household.
the account menu offered no "Switch Profile" entry. Either the menu did not open, or this account has no household (ONB-020). getByRole('menuitem', { name: /Switch Profile|Changer de profil/i })
Click getByRole('menuitem', { name: /Switch Profile|Changer de profil/i })

the switch dialog listed no child called "Alnf Child".
ROLE_PARENT_CHILD_NAME must match a profile that exists in this environment's household - the dialog shows the name the API returns, which for a child created by ONB-021 is "<first> <last>". getByRole('dialog').getByRole('button').filter({ hasText: 'Alnf Child' })

the profile switch was rejected (200). A 401 is usually a wrong ROLE_PARENT_CHILD_PIN - note the app locks a profile after 5 CONSECUTIVE failures (PAR-006), and the lockout outlives the run, though a correct PIN resets the counter. A 409 carrying P2002 on 'token' is the same-second refresh-token collision described above; seeing it here means it survived the one retry.
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: /Switch to Parent|Passer au profil parent/i })
Click getByRole('button', { name: /^Request Extension$/i }).filter({ visible: true }).first()
clicking "Request Extension" on the household page did not navigate to Settings.

no "Request Extension" control on Settings after arriving via the household page's own link - see this class's header comment if this starts failing again. getByRole('button', { name: /^Request Extension$/i }).filter({ visible: true }).first()
Click getByRole('button', { name: /^Request Extension$/i }).filter({ visible: true }).first()
the Request Screen Time Extension modal did not open. getByRole('heading', { name: /^Request Screen Time Extension$/i }).first()
Fill "Automated smoke test (CR-010 round trip)" getByPlaceholder(/Why do you need more screen time/i).filter({ visible: true }).first()
Click getByRole('button', { name: /^Send Request$/i }).filter({ visible: true }).first()
submitting the extension request sent no response.
the 37-minute request never appeared in the child's own "Recent Requests" list after sending it. getByText('37 minutes', { exact: true }).filter({ visible: true }).first()
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: /Switch to Parent|Passer au profil parent/i })
Click getByRole('button', { name: /Switch to Parent|Passer au profil parent/i }).first()
the "Switch to Parent" PIN modal never opened, so nothing proves the switch back is gated on a PIN at all. locator('input[type="password"][inputmode="numeric"]:visible')
the account menu did not close, so its focus trap will keep the PIN field inert however it is typed into. locator('[role="menu"]')
Click locator('button[type="submit"]').filter({ hasText: /Switch to Parent|Passer au profil parent/i })
the switch back to the parent was rejected (200). A 409 here is the PAR-006 lockout, not a wrong PIN in .env - it outlives the run, so wait it out rather than re-running immediately.
Click getByRole('button', { name: /Screen Time Requests|Demandes de temps d'[ée]cran/i }).filter({ visible: true }).first()
the Screen Time Requests modal did not open. getByRole('heading', { name: /Screen Time Requests|Demandes de temps d'[ée]cran/i }).first()
Click getByRole('button', { name: /Pending|En attente/i }).filter({ visible: true }).first()
Expect "toPass"
Click getByRole('button', { name: /Pending|En attente/i }).filter({ visible: true }).first()
no pending screen-time request found for "Alnf Child" at 37 minutes. locator('div').filter({ has: getByText('Alnf Child') }).filter({ has: getByText(/\b37\s+minutes\b/) }).first()
